title_vi: Trình duyệt dựng trang web thế nào?

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: CSSOM được dựng từ các luật CSS mà bài CSS giải thích.

claims.evidence: MDN pages read from a local clone of mdn/content; the display:none / visibility:hidden behaviour measured in Chromium 141.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: The render tree is built from the DOM and CSSOM; head and display:none nodes are left out, visibility:hidden nodes are kept because they take up space.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: Rendering steps are style, layout, paint and, in some cases, compositing on the GPU; reflow is any later size/position determination.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: Waiting for CSS does not block HTML parsing but does block JavaScript; some resource requests block the parsing of the rest of the HTML.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: Changing width or left adds one layout pass in Chromium 141 (LayoutCount via CDP); changing the transform value of an element that already has a transform adds none. Applying a transform to an element that had none can still trigger one layout.
A 40px-high div with visibility:hidden keeps its 40px height while the same div with display:none measures 0.

design_notes_vi: Sáu thẻ; DOM và CSSOM đặt cạnh nhau rồi mới có mũi tên vào render tree vì chúng độc lập. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source ends with a 'Display' step that sends pixels to the GPU; MDN describes compositing as happening only in some cases, so the figure separates paint from an optional compositing step.
Source says the render tree leaves out invisible elements such as head or display:none; the lesson adds that visibility:hidden elements stay because they take up space.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
